sources.snippet: About Qwen2.5-3B Qwen2.5-3B is a foundational large language model developed by Alibaba Cloud, forming a part of the broader Qwen2.5 series. This model is primarily designed for advanced natural language processing tasks, serving as a robust base model that can be further fine-tuned for specific applications.
